description: Test suite for the SessionData-related components including SessionKind, SessionTokenStats, and SessionRow, verifying their behavior and properties.

classes.name: SessionDataTests
classes.description: Test suite containing multiple unit tests for session data components.

methods.name: `session kind from key detects common kinds`
methods.description: Tests the 'from' method of SessionKind to correctly identify session types based on key strings.

methods.name: `session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected`
methods.description: Verifies that the formatting of token counts into string representations is correct.

methods.name: `session token stats percent used clamps to100`
methods.description: Ensures that the 'percentUsed' property of SessionTokenStats is capped at 100%.

methods.name: `session row flag labels include non default flags`
methods.description: Checks that the flag labels for a SessionRow correctly include non-default flags such as 'think high' and 'system sent'.
